title: Collector's Notes - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Collector's Notes trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Collector's Notes phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Game8 lists a different silver in this slot - Unsung Legend, for completing the Enemy Journal - and does not list this one at all. Four other lists carry Collector's Notes with the 30-accessory requirement, so that is the version recorded here. If your list shows Unsung Legend instead, the collectible trophy on your platform is the journal rather than the accessories.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 16 of 36 on the list - before it Saw It Through · after it Forbidden Arts Beneath the Lake. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
